subject: Renewal kickoff + capacity uptick planning
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>, Ahmed Latif <ahmed@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff + capacity uptick planning

Hi Priya / Ahmed —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As discussed, it sounds like Acme Health is planning a renewal in Q3 and is evaluating a 12‑month commit with an uplift in token capacity to support the new chat + summarization workload. I wanted to kick off the formal renewal thread so we have a single place for timeline, stakeholders, and the QBR scheduling.

High‑level proposal / next steps (suggested):
- Timeline: Target signature by end of June (30‑day runway) so we can lock capacity for July onboarding.
- Commercial ask: 12‑month term, ~20% committed uplift (exact sizing TBC after usage review).
- Operational ask: Dedicated burst pool + KV cache retention increase.
- QBR: schedule a kickoff readout + tech runbook review in the week of June 7 — 2 options below.

Can you please:
1) Confirm the procurement contact we should loop in (I cc'd procurement@acmehealth.com if that's correct).
2) Share any mandatory stakeholders from legal/finance/infra who must join the QBR.
3) Pick a 60‑minute slot for the kickoff (I propose June 8 10:00–11:00 PT or June 9 9:00–10:00 PT).

Attached is a first‑pass mutual action plan (Acme_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx) and a short checklist for the QBR. From our side: Marissa will run the QBR, Ben will draft a technical scaling runbook, and I will prepare commercial terms and a preliminary price worksheet. Rishi is looped for any concession approvals.

If that timeline looks tight for you, happy to extend the runway — just let me know constraints.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555‑0132

From: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>

Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff + capacity uptick planning

Thanks Mateo — this looks good and aligns with our internal thinking. A few quick notes: 

- We are aiming for a 12‑month term and are interested in roughly a 20% uplift to committed capacity; final numbers will depend on your usage delta analysis.
- Procurement contact is procurement@acmehealth.com (copied). Legal will want to see any standard amendments; I can pull in our finance lead if you want once we have pricing.
- June 8 10:00–11:00 PT works for me for the kickoff QBR. Ahmed will join as technical lead.

Please send an invite for June 8 and any prereads (MAP + runbook draft) so we can circulate internally.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Director, Data Platform | Acme Health

Perfect — locking June 8 10:00–11:00 PT. Invite will follow from Marissa.

Quick clarifications inline: 
> We are aiming for a 12‑month term and are interested in roughly a 20% uplift to committed capacity; final numbers will depend on your usage delta analysis.

Absolutely — Ben will run the usage delta and a sizing exercise ahead of the QBR. I'll share a preliminary price worksheet and a draft amendment (term + commit) so procurement/legal can see the change set.

> Please send an invite for June 8 and any prereads (MAP + runbook draft) so we can circulate internally.

Attached: Acme_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (MAP) — it has owner fields and a proposed signoff timeline. Ben attached a short Scale_Runbook_Draft.pdf (technical notes) — Marissa will push the calendar invite and a short agenda.

If legal has any must‑have clauses, please send them over now; otherwise we'll include our standard amendment and highlight changes.

On Redwood side: Marissa (CS) will run the QBR, Ben (SE) is preparing the runbook + performance profile, and Rishi (Sales Director) will review commercial flex.

Thanks,
Mateo

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Renewal kickoff — internal plan and asks (Acme Health)

Marissa / Ben / Rishi —

Recap: Acme Health is targeting a 12‑month renewal + ~20% committed capacity uplift. They confirmed June 8 10:00 PT for the kickoff QBR. Procurement is copied.

Internal asks / owners:
- Marissa: run QBR, assemble 30‑minute product readout + 30‑minute ops runbook review. Prepare agenda and calendar invite.
- Ben: deliver usage delta analysis and a concise scaling runbook (attached draft). Highlight any infra limitations and list action items for the first 30 days post‑signing.
- Rishi: commercial backstop — if we need to offer a concession to land the commit, what's the maximum range you can approve (we typically keep concessions < 15% without Exec signoff). Flag any pricing constraints.

Other notes:
- Materials: finalize MAP and runbook before EOD Friday so we can share pre‑reads with Acme.
- Legal/compliance: if they send contract redlines, we'll route to Legal and aim for 48‑72 hour turnaround.

I'll handle the commercial worksheet and update the HubSpot deal. Please confirm owners and ETA for deliverables.

Thanks,
Mateo

1) 10 min — Introductions & renewal goals (Priya)
2) 20 min — Commercial overview & amendment highlights (Mateo)
3) 20 min — Technical scaling runbook + performance profile (Ben)
4) 10 min — Next steps, owners, and closeout (Marissa)

Prereads: Acme_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx, Scale_Runbook_Draft.pdf (attached).
Poll / invite link: https://calendar.google.com/event?action=VIEW&eid=samplepolllink

If you prefer a different time, reply with "Option B" and we'll pivot — otherwise I'll send the calendar invite for June 8 10:00–11:00 PT and include a short GoToMeeting link.
